methodology_notes.benchmark_origin: The initial question pool was prepared with assistance from multiple cloud chatbots and DeepSeek, then reviewed and filtered to keep broad AI/CV programming tasks. Question-author, reference-answer, and judge bias may still remain.
methodology_notes.evaluation_pipeline: Evaluation was not based only on similarity to a reference implementation. The published score combines functional correctness, robustness/edge cases, API/specification compliance, algorithmic flow/design, generated-code runtime efficiency, and code clarity/maintainability using the weights listed above.
methodology_notes.reference_answer_policy: Reference implementations were treated as evaluation aids rather than infallible ground truth. Requirements and actual behavior were reviewed separately when reference behavior appeared questionable.
methodology_notes.qwen_serving_condition: Qwen 3.8 120B was executed on constrained/self-hosted hardware. Long reasoning made several tasks slow, and some missing tasks required recovery with a tighter output budget and reduced/disabled thinking.
methodology_notes.chatgpt_serving_condition: GPT-5.6 Sol was accessed through cloud infrastructure, so model-response latency was not directly comparable to the self-hosted Qwen environment.
methodology_notes.latency_policy: Model response-generation latency is not given a numeric comparison score. The runtime score refers to execution efficiency of the generated code, not model inference speed.
methodology_notes.cross_evaluation_status: Completed in Phase 2 and reported separately in cross_eval_summary.json.
methodology_notes.qwen_phase1_generation_regime_caveat: The final Phase-1 Qwen answer set includes recovery runs for previously missing tasks. Those recovery runs used a tighter output budget and reduced/disabled thinking, so the 30-task Phase-1 Qwen set should not be described as a single frozen generation configuration.

interpretation_warning: These are benchmark-specific engineering results on 30 tasks and should not be interpreted as universal model accuracy or a definitive ranking of model intelligence.
